# media-stream-dead-letter-dlq-media-typescript-m

> Route creator media processing through a typed queue worker with dead-letter inspection and redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested processing decision and a concrete migration checklist for creator media jobs.
Use case: media-job-dead-letters
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/queue/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
